## AI Chatbot Training Data Generator

**Setup:**
1. Connect OpenAI API, Gmail OAuth2, Google Sheets OAuth2
2. Set spreadsheet ID for training dataset storage
3. POST to webhook: `{"topic": "Product Returns", "domain": "E-commerce", "tone": "Friendly", "language": "English", "count": 20, "notify_email": "ai@company.com"}`

Generates Q&A pairs with intent labels, entity extraction, and question variations. Saves each pair as a row in Sheets for easy import into chatbot platforms (Dialogflow, Rasa, etc.).
